decision.summary: A sustained E-axis drop begins around index 570 and continues through 729 without recovery; N and U show no coherent temporary offset. No opposing return observed for E within allowed context, so the interval is classified as uncertain.

intervals.observation: E drops sharply from ~-10.8 to ~-14.5 between indices 570–615, then remains near -13 to -14 with minor fluctuations through 729; no return to pre-drop levels observed. N shows modest variability (~-7 to -12) without clear platform or reversal. U fluctuates between -4 and -9, no sustained offset. The E decline lacks a confirmed return within allowed context (570–729), so status is uncertain.
